title: Price doubled mid purchase
text: Price doubled mid purchase. I had added this white creche to my cart to buy at $31 and in a matter of seconds at complete purchase button it changed price to $59. I cant afford a double increase in price even if the item looks nice and would work well with my white snowman nativity better than my wooden manger. So would like to be notified when the price is back to normal again so I can buy this.
